user.title: Set up Room Daylight
user.description: Choose the house-wide daylight sources. Rooms and connections are managed as subentries after setup.

model_defaults.name: Model defaults
model_defaults.description: Defaults used for newly configured rooms, glazing and connections. These are automation-oriented heuristic parameters rather than architectural simulation settings.

data_description.diffuse_fraction: The share of incoming daylight treated as diffuse sky light rather than direct sunlight.
data_description.glazing_transmission: Default fraction of daylight transmitted through newly configured exterior glazing.
data_description.daylight_utilisation: Default room-level fraction of admitted daylight treated as useful room illuminance.
data_description.transfer_efficiency: Default efficiency applied when daylight transfers through newly configured room connections.
data_description.sensor_correction_strength: Default blend strength for local indoor lux sensor correction in newly configured rooms.

data_description.outdoor_illuminance_entity: An outdoor illuminance sensor reporting the current exterior light level in lux.
data_description.sun_entity: The Home Assistant sun entity used for solar azimuth and elevation.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Room Daylight
reconfigure.description: Update the global daylight sources or default model parameters.

model_defaults.name: Model defaults
model_defaults.description: Diffuse daylight fraction applies globally. The other values are defaults used when configuring new rooms, openings and connections; existing subentry values remain unchanged.

data_description.diffuse_fraction: The share of incoming daylight treated as diffuse sky light rather than direct sunlight.
data_description.glazing_transmission: Default fraction of daylight transmitted through newly configured exterior glazing.
data_description.daylight_utilisation: Default room-level fraction of admitted daylight treated as useful room illuminance.
data_description.transfer_efficiency: Default efficiency applied when daylight transfers through newly configured room connections.
data_description.sensor_correction_strength: Default blend strength for local indoor lux sensor correction in newly configured rooms.

data_description.outdoor_illuminance_entity: An outdoor illuminance sensor reporting the current exterior light level in lux.
data_description.sun_entity: The Home Assistant sun entity used for solar azimuth and elevation.

user.title: Add room
user.description: Configure a room. Internal rooms may have zero exterior glazed openings.

room_model.name: Room model
room_model.description: Room-specific tuning. The defaults shown come from the global model settings.

data_description.daylight_utilisation: Scales admitted exterior daylight to an automation-oriented room illuminance estimate.
data_description.sensor_correction_strength: Controls how strongly valid local lux readings adjust the modelled daylight value.

data_description.room_name: A friendly name for the room. Renaming it does not change the room identity.
data_description.floor_area_m2: Approximate floor area used to scale exterior and transferred daylight.
data_description.area_id: Optional Home Assistant area used as the suggested area for the room device.
data_description.opening_count: Number of exterior glazed surfaces admitting daylight directly from outside. Use 0 for internal rooms.
data_description.indoor_lux_sensors: Optional local illuminance sensors used only to correct this room after network transfer.
data_description.artificial_light_entities: Lights or switches whose active or unavailable state suppresses indoor sensor correction.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure room
reconfigure.description: Update the room, its local sensors and its exterior glazed openings.

room_model.name: Room model
room_model.description: Tune how strongly exterior daylight and local lux sensors influence this room.

data_description.daylight_utilisation: Scales admitted exterior daylight to an automation-oriented room illuminance estimate.
data_description.sensor_correction_strength: Controls how strongly valid local lux readings adjust the modelled daylight value.

data_description.room_name: A friendly name for the room. Renaming it does not change the room identity.
data_description.floor_area_m2: Approximate floor area used to scale exterior and transferred daylight.
data_description.area_id: Optional Home Assistant area used as the suggested area for the room device.
data_description.opening_count: Number of exterior glazed surfaces admitting daylight directly from outside. Use 0 for internal rooms.
data_description.indoor_lux_sensors: Optional local illuminance sensors used only to correct this room after network transfer.
data_description.artificial_light_entities: Lights or switches whose active or unavailable state suppresses indoor sensor correction.

opening.title: Exterior opening {number} of {total}
opening.description: Choose how this glazed surface is mounted.

data_description.type: Choose the geometry that best describes this exterior glazed surface.

opening_details.title: Exterior opening {number} of {total}
opening_details.description: Configure the glazed dimensions and outward-facing orientation. Azimuth is clockwise from north (0° north, 90° east, 180° south, 270° west).

data_description.name: A friendly diagnostic name for this glazed opening.
data_description.length_m: Glazed length in metres for a rooflight.
data_description.roof_pitch_deg: Tilt from horizontal. 0° is flat and sky-facing; 90° is vertical.
data_description.azimuth_deg: Outward-facing compass direction measured clockwise from north.
data_description.tilt_deg: Custom plane tilt from horizontal. 0° faces the sky; 90° is vertical.
data_description.cover_entity: Optional cover controlling this opening. When its state cannot be used, Room Daylight falls back to the configured assumed blind state.
data_description.assumed_state: State used when no blind/curtain entity is configured, or when the configured cover is unavailable or unknown.
data_description.transmission: Fraction of incident daylight transmitted through the glazing before any cover reduction.

user.title: Add room connection
user.description: Create a physical opening through which daylight can pass between two configured rooms. Multiple connections between the same rooms are allowed.

connection_model.name: Transfer model
connection_model.description: Controls how efficiently daylight passes through this opening.

data_description.transfer_efficiency: Scales daylight transfer through this opening after area and open-state transmission are applied.

data_description.connection_name: Optional friendly name. Leave blank to use the two room names automatically.
data_description.room_a: One room at this physical opening.
data_description.room_b: The room on the other side of the opening.
data_description.connection_type: Choose the geometry that best describes the internal opening.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure room connection
reconfigure.description: Update the rooms, opening type or transfer model.

connection_model.name: Transfer model
connection_model.description: Controls how efficiently daylight passes through this opening.

data_description.transfer_efficiency: Scales daylight transfer through this opening after area and open-state transmission are applied.

data_description.connection_name: Optional friendly name. Leave blank to use the two room names automatically.
data_description.room_a: One room at this physical opening.
data_description.room_b: The room on the other side of the opening.
data_description.connection_type: Choose the geometry that best describes the internal opening.

connection_details.title: Connection details
connection_details.description: A state entity is optional. The assumed connection state is used whenever no usable entity state is available.

data_description.length_m: Approximate floor-opening length in metres for a stairwell.
data_description.state_entity: Optional binary sensor, input boolean or cover describing whether the opening is open. A usable entity state overrides the configured assumption.
data_description.assumed_state: State used when no door/opening entity is configured, or when the configured entity is unavailable or unknown.
data_description.invert_state: Reverse known entity open/closed semantics. The configured assumed state is not inverted.
data_description.closed_transmission: Fraction of daylight that may pass while the connection is closed, useful for glazed internal doors.

error.same_room: Room A and Room B must be different rooms.

abort.need_two_rooms: Configure at least two rooms before adding a connection.
